author: Murphh
body:
Hi - I've set up a UHC map on my Realms and I want to test the command blocks out to see if its works.  I need between 4-10 players.
I'm testing today at 9am, 1pm, and 7pm PST.  So the first test starts in 25 minutes.

If you'd like to help test, just let me know your ign, so I can invite you and which time works best for you.

Thanks for the help!!
